title: Detroit: Become Human
summary: Experimental RenoDX Vulkan HDR, ultrawide, DLAA, and native DOF v2 support for Detroit: Become Human.
notes: Vulkan base pinned to RenoDX PR #564 commit 92d6d79ec8103b1aaea44c0085c3a88db723e6d5.
Requires ReShade 6.8.0 Full Add-On and the game's native Vulkan renderer.
Adds NVIDIA NGX DLAA at native resolution with a separate HDR-safe sharpening control; the in-game Resolution Scaling setting must be 100%, and reduced render extents fail closed to native TAA.

Adds opt-in native DOF v2 with Clean, Cinematic, and Retinal styles. Enhanced styles use full-resolution far-focus boundaries while preserving Detroit's authored foreground bokeh at the exact Vanilla strength; Cinematic restores authored far color through a full-resolution Gaussian CoC gradient while half-resolution R8 far alpha is restricted to color validation and never controls visibility, preventing moving silhouette masks and uniform gameplay haze, then restores confirmed deep background bokeh, while Retinal adds a full-resolution Watson acuity filter with paired hardware-linear Gaussian taps. Vanilla remains the exact default path, and unsupported or incomplete shader chains fail closed.
The addon now embeds the Vulkan/NGX bootstrap. No launcher, separate Vulkan layer, global registration, or Steam launch option is required.
The first launch configures ADDON.LoadFromDllMain and caches verified NGX Vulkan extension requirements; restart once before enabling DLAA.
The release package contains renodx-detroitbecomehuman.addon64 and the official nvngx_dlss.dll. DLSS Super Resolution, Frame Generation and Streamline are not included.
Adds an automatic, reversible aspect-ratio override for displays wider than 16:9; 3440x1440 uses its exact 43:18 scene ratio while Detroit's native Scaleform half-extent remains untouched.
The earlier aspect-derived UI scaling was removed because it enlarged both axes and could move HUD elements beyond the bottom-right edge.
RenoDX Preset Off disables HDR look changes but keeps ultrawide compatibility active; select Aspect Ratio: Vanilla 16:9 to disable the geometry override.
The ultrawide aspect signature was independently reimplemented from research published by Rose / PCGamingWiki; no trainer binary or Cheat Engine payload is included.
Fully restart the game after adding, replacing, or removing the addon; live addon unload/reload is not supported.
Auto HDR and NVIDIA RTX HDR must be disabled. Late chapters remain user-validation for this experimental RC.
